request.subject: CRUMBS

layers.text: Recolour and change no shape: the pink frosting bits among the crumbs become dark chocolate #4a2412 chips with a lighter #7a4526 shine. No pink is left. Keep the golden biscuit pieces, the crumbs, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
